ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line $y=kx+b$ ($k\neq 0$) intersects the x-axis at point $A(6,0)$ and the y-axis at point $B(0,3)$, and intersects the line $y=x$ at point $C$. What is the area of $\triangle BOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given the conditions, we have $B(0, 3)$, $O(0, 0)$, $C(2, 2)$,\\
$\therefore S_{\triangle BOC}=\frac{1}{2}OB\cdot|x_{C}|=\frac{1}{2}\times 3\times 2=\boxed{3}$.
